name: Indian Bank
summary: Indian Bank provides various banking products and services. It offers deposit products, including savings bank and current accounts, term deposits, and non-resident Indian (NRI) accounts. The company also provides agriculture, MSME, corporate, online, home, mortgage, vehicle, personal, educational, and jewel loans; supply chain finance; 59 minutes loans; loan/OD against deposits, NSC/KVP/ relief bonds of RBI/LIC policies; and other retail/personal loans.
